contentText:
Venezuela's former leader Nicolas Maduro is due in a New York court on Monday ⁠to face drug charges while the UN was to scrutinize the legality of US President Donald Trump's extraordinary operation to capture

him. In the meantime, the situation in Venezuela remains very uncertain, on both the short and long term. Analysis by Tiziano Breda, senior analyst of Latin America and the Caribbean at ACLED, in Rome.
